findings.title: Redundant double scrub (whole-buffer + per-sample input)
findings.detail: scrubInvalidSamples runs over the full buffer at block entry, and sanitizeAudioSample also runs on each input sample inside the stage loop. Value-preserving, negligible cost; defense-in-depth.

findings.title: 1e-30 flush applied to input and output
findings.detail: sanitizeAudioSample flushes |x| < 1e-30 (approx -600 dBFS) to zero on both input and output. Below denormal-relevance and inaudible; no tone impact.

findings.title: Cabinet oversized guard pre-existing
findings.detail: Cabinets already had scrubInvalidSamples + canProcessBlock oversized guard; patch correctly adds only the missing ScopedNoDenormals. No new cabinet capacity guard required.

findings.title: Clean Amp not hardened (deferred parity)
findings.detail: Clean Amp is unmodified (out of scope) yet included in oversized finite test with null-RMS assertion correctly skipped. Future parity pass could extend same guards to Clean Amp.

findings.title: Per-block O(n) scrub pass on hot path
findings.detail: Each amp adds a full linear buffer traversal per block. Validation shows 0 failures; acceptable for the safety gain.

validation_crosscheck.method: static source inspection + reliance on reported runs
